How It Works

Our 5-step process

01

Free consultation

We visit your home, listen to your vision, and assess what's involved. No obligation, no pressure.

02

Detailed estimate

You receive a written, itemised quote within a few days. No hidden fees, no vague line items.

03

Project kickoff

We handle permits, schedule the crew, and keep you informed before we lift a tool.

04

Build & update

Your dedicated project manager keeps you updated at every stage. You always know what's happening.

05

Final walkthrough

We walk through the finished project together. Nothing is closed out until you're satisfied.
